# AI Hub · Story board

<!-- Generated by build-board.py. Edit the story files, then run `python3 stories/build-board.py`. -->

One file per story, ready to copy into Jira, Trello, Linear or GitHub Projects. Each card links to its AI-ready handover in [`../implementation-specs/`](../implementation-specs/).

**46 stories · 112 points · 0 done.** Build top to bottom: every story only depends on stories above it.

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `type` | **Story** = user-facing value · **Task** = technical enabler |
| `priority` | Highest → Low (Jira scale) |
| `points` | Fibonacci estimate (1 = under an hour with AI, 8 = a full session) |
| `status` | To Do · In Progress · In Review · Done |
| `depends_on` | Finish these first |

**Import:** [`board.csv`](board.csv) works with Jira (*System → External system import → CSV*) and Trello (via a CSV import Power-Up, or copy cards by hand). Stories marked "Added story" aren't in SPEC.md §2 but are needed to deliver it.
